name: Asset Register 360
report_script:
# =====================================================================
#  Asset Register 360  —  Script Report (Is Standard = No)
#  الصق الكود ده في خانة "Report Script" في الـ Report
#  متوافق مع ERPNext v14 / v15 — بيشتغل جوه الـ Server Script sandbox
# =====================================================================

def run_report(filters):
    flt = frappe.utils.flt
    getdate = frappe.utils.getdate

    # ---------------- helpers ----------------
    def as_list(v):
        if not v:
            return []
        if isinstance(v, (list, tuple)):
            return list(v)
        v = str(v).strip()
        if v.startswith("["):
            return json.loads(v) or []
        out = []
        for x in v.split(","):
            if x.strip():
                out.append(x.strip())
        return out

    def has_field(dt, fieldname):
        try:
            return frappe.get_meta(dt).has_field(fieldname)
        except Exception:
            return False

    def dt_exists(dt):
        return bool(frappe.db.exists("DocType", dt))

    def between(d, a, b):
        return d is not None and d >= a and d <= b

    def to_date_or_none(v):
        if not v:
            return None
        return getdate(v)

    def col(label, fieldname, fieldtype="Data", options=None, width=120):
        c = {"label": label, "fieldname": fieldname, "fieldtype": fieldtype, "width": width}
        if options:
            c["options"] = options
        return c

    # ---------------- filters ----------------
    company = filters.get("company")
    if not company:
        frappe.throw("Please select a Company")

    today = getdate(frappe.utils.nowdate())
    to_date = getdate(filters.get("to_date") or today)
    from_date = getdate(filters.get("from_date") or to_date.replace(month=1, day=1))
    if from_date > to_date:
        frappe.throw("From Date can not be after To Date")

    fb_filter = filters.get("finance_book") or None
    include_default_fb = frappe.utils.cint(filters.get("include_default_book")) == 1
    statuses = as_list(filters.get("status"))
    source_filter = filters.get("source_type") or None
    pi_filter = filters.get("purchase_invoice") or None
    group_by = filters.get("group_by") or None
    summary_only = frappe.utils.cint(filters.get("summary_only")) == 1
    include_old_disposed = frappe.utils.cint(filters.get("include_disposed_before")) == 1
    hide_zero = frappe.utils.cint(filters.get("hide_zero_rows")) == 1

    company_info = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Company", company, ["default_currency", "accumulated_depreciation_account"], as_dict=True
    ) or {}
    currency = company_info.get("default_currency")

    # ---------------- columns ----------------
    columns = [
        col("Asset", "asset", "Link", "Asset", 150),
        col("Asset Name", "asset_name", "Data", None, 200),
        col("Item Code", "item_code", "Link", "Item", 120),
        col("Asset Category", "asset_category", "Link", "Asset Category", 140),
        col("Status", "status", "Data", None, 140),
        col("Source Type", "source_type", "Data", None, 140),
        col("Source Document", "source_doc", "Dynamic Link", "source_type", 160),
        col("Purchase Invoice", "purchase_invoice", "Link", "Purchase Invoice", 160),
        col("Purchase Receipt", "purchase_receipt", "Link", "Purchase Receipt", 150),
        col("Supplier", "supplier", "Link", "Supplier", 150),
        col("Purchase Date", "purchase_date", "Date", None, 105),
        col("Available For Use", "available_for_use_date", "Date", None, 105),
        col("Location", "location", "Link", "Location", 130),
        col("Cost Center", "cost_center", "Link", "Cost Center", 140),
        col("Department", "department", "Link", "Department", 130),
        col("Custodian", "custodian", "Link", "Employee", 120),
        col("Qty", "qty", "Float", None, 60),
        col("Depreciation Method", "dep_method", "Data", None, 130),
        col("No. of Depreciations", "dep_count", "Int", None, 90),
        col("Freq. (Months)", "dep_freq", "Int", None, 80),
        # ---- cost
        col("Opening Cost", "opening_cost", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Additions", "additions", "Currency", None, 120),
        col("Capitalized Repairs", "cap_repairs", "Currency", None, 120),
        col("Disposals (Cost)", "disposal_cost", "Currency", None, 120),
        col("Closing Cost", "closing_cost", "Currency", None, 130),
        # ---- accumulated depreciation
        col("Opening Acc. Dep.", "opening_acc_dep", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Acc. Dep. Brought In", "acc_dep_brought_in", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Depreciation (Period)", "dep_period", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Value Adjustment (Period)", "value_adj_period", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Acc. Dep. Eliminated", "acc_dep_eliminated", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Closing Acc. Dep.", "closing_acc_dep", "Currency", None, 130),
        # ---- net book value
        col("Opening NBV", "opening_nbv", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Closing NBV", "closing_nbv", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("System Book Value (Now)", "system_nbv", "Currency", None, 130),
        col("Variance vs System", "variance", "Currency", None, 120),
        # ---- disposal
        col("Disposal Date", "disposal_date", "Date", None, 105),
        col("Disposal Doc Type", "disposal_doctype", "Data", None, 120),
        col("Disposal Document", "disposal_doc", "Dynamic Link", "disposal_doctype", 150),
        col("Sale Amount", "sale_amount", "Currency", None, 120),
        col("Gain / (Loss)", "gain_loss", "Currency", None, 120),
        # ---- activity
        col("Movements", "movements", "Int", None, 80),
        col("Repairs", "repairs", "Int", None, 70),
        col("Maintenance Logs", "maint_logs", "Int", None, 80),
        col("Last Depreciation Date", "last_dep_date", "Date", None, 105),
    ]

    num_fields = [
        "qty", "opening_cost", "additions", "cap_repairs", "disposal_cost", "closing_cost",
        "opening_acc_dep", "acc_dep_brought_in", "dep_period", "value_adj_period",
        "acc_dep_eliminated", "closing_acc_dep", "opening_nbv", "closing_nbv",
        "system_nbv", "variance", "sale_amount", "gain_loss",
        "movements", "repairs", "maint_logs",
    ]

    # ---------------- assets ----------------
    asset_fields = [
        "name", "asset_name", "item_code", "asset_category", "location", "custodian",
        "department", "cost_center", "status", "docstatus", "purchase_date",
        "available_for_use_date", "opening_accumulated_depreciation",
        "purchase_invoice", "purchase_receipt", "supplier", "disposal_date",
        "is_existing_asset", "journal_entry_for_scrap", "asset_quantity",
        "calculate_depreciation", "value_after_depreciation",
    ]
    # ERPNext v16 renamed gross_purchase_amount -> net_purchase_amount
    cost_field = None
    for cf in ["net_purchase_amount", "gross_purchase_amount", "purchase_amount"]:
        if has_field("Asset", cf):
            cost_field = cf
            break
    if cost_field:
        asset_fields.append(cost_field)

    fields = []
    for f in asset_fields:
        if f in ("name", "docstatus") or has_field("Asset", f):
            fields.append(f)

    af = {"company": company}
    if "Cancelled" in statuses:
        af["docstatus"] = ["in", [0, 1, 2]]
    else:
        af["docstatus"] = ["in", [0, 1]]
    for pair in [["asset_category", "asset_category"], ["location", "location"],
                 ["cost_center", "cost_center"], ["department", "department"], ["asset", "name"]]:
        vals = as_list(filters.get(pair[0]))
        if vals:
            af[pair[1]] = ["in", vals]
    for key in ["custodian", "supplier", "item_code"]:
        if filters.get(key) and has_field("Asset", key):
            af[key] = filters.get(key)

    # row-level permission check on names only (avoids field-level permission errors),
    # then read the financial fields directly — access to the report itself is controlled by its Roles
    allowed = frappe.get_list("Asset", filters=af, fields=["name"], limit_page_length=0)
    if not allowed:
        return columns, [], None, None, []
    allowed_names = []
    for x in allowed:
        allowed_names.append(x.name)
    sel = []
    for f in fields:
        sel.append("`" + f + "`")
    assets = frappe.db.sql("select " + ", ".join(sel) + " from `tabAsset` where name in %(n)s order by name",
                           {"n": tuple(allowed_names)}, as_dict=True)

    names = []
    prs = []
    for a in assets:
        names.append(a.name)
        if a.get("purchase_receipt") and a.get("purchase_receipt") not in prs:
            prs.append(a.get("purchase_receipt"))
    names_t = tuple(names)

    # ---------------- finance books ----------------
    afb_by_asset = {}
    rows = frappe.db.sql("""
        select parent, idx, finance_book, depreciation_method, total_number_of_depreciations,
               frequency_of_depreciation, value_after_depreciation
        from `tabAsset Finance Book`
        where parenttype = 'Asset' and parent in %(n)s
        order by parent, idx""", {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True)
    for r in rows:
        afb_by_asset.setdefault(r.parent, []).append(r)

    def pick_fb_row(asset_name):
        lst = afb_by_asset.get(asset_name) or []
        if not lst:
            return None
        if fb_filter:
            for r in lst:
                if r.finance_book == fb_filter:
                    return r
            if include_default_fb:
                for r in lst:
                    if not r.finance_book:
                        return r
            return None
        return lst[0]

    # ---------------- accumulated depreciation accounts ----------------
    acc_dep_accounts = []
    for r in frappe.db.sql("""
            select distinct accumulated_depreciation_account as acc
            from `tabAsset Category Account`
            where company_name = %(c)s and ifnull(accumulated_depreciation_account,'') != ''""",
            {"c": company}, as_dict=True):
        acc_dep_accounts.append(r.acc)
    if company_info.get("accumulated_depreciation_account") and \
            company_info.get("accumulated_depreciation_account") not in acc_dep_accounts:
        acc_dep_accounts.append(company_info.get("accumulated_depreciation_account"))

    # ---------------- value adjustments (JE names) ----------------
    ava_jes = set()
    if dt_exists("Asset Value Adjustment") and has_field("Asset Value Adjustment", "journal_entry"):
        for r in frappe.db.sql("""
                select journal_entry from `tabAsset Value Adjustment`
                where docstatus = 1 and asset in %(n)s and ifnull(journal_entry,'') != ''""",
                {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True):
            ava_jes.add(r.journal_entry)

    # ---------------- depreciation / adjustment journal rows ----------------
    je_rows_by_asset = {}
    if acc_dep_accounts:
        rows = frappe.db.sql("""
            select jea.reference_name as asset, je.name as je, je.posting_date,
                   ifnull(je.finance_book,'') as finance_book,
                   sum(ifnull(jea.credit,0) - ifnull(jea.debit,0)) as amount
            from `tabJournal Entry Account` jea
            inner join `tabJournal Entry` je on je.name = jea.parent
            where je.docstatus = 1 and je.company = %(c)s
              and jea.reference_type = 'Asset' and jea.reference_name in %(n)s
              and jea.account in %(a)s and je.posting_date <= %(t)s
            group by jea.reference_name, je.name, je.posting_date, je.finance_book
            order by je.posting_date""",
            {"c": company, "n": names_t, "a": tuple(acc_dep_accounts), "t": to_date}, as_dict=True)
        for r in rows:
            je_rows_by_asset.setdefault(r.asset, []).append(r)

    # ---------------- capitalized repairs ----------------
    repairs_by_asset = {}
    repair_count = {}
    if dt_exists("Asset Repair") and has_field("Asset Repair", "asset"):
        rep_cost_field = "repair_cost"
        if has_field("Asset Repair", "total_repair_cost"):
            rep_cost_field = "total_repair_cost"
        cap_sql = "0"
        if has_field("Asset Repair", "capitalize_repair_cost"):
            cap_sql = "ifnull(capitalize_repair_cost,0)"
        date_sql = "posting_date"
        if has_field("Asset Repair", "completion_date"):
            date_sql = "ifnull(completion_date, failure_date)"
        rows = frappe.db.sql(
            "select asset, docstatus, " + cap_sql + " as cap, ifnull(" + rep_cost_field + ",0) as amt, "
            + date_sql + " as dt from `tabAsset Repair` where docstatus < 2 and asset in %(n)s",
            {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True)
        for r in rows:
            repair_count[r.asset] = (repair_count.get(r.asset) or 0) + 1
            if r.docstatus == 1 and r.cap:
                repairs_by_asset.setdefault(r.asset, []).append(r)

    # ---------------- movements / maintenance ----------------
    move_count = {}
    if dt_exists("Asset Movement Item"):
        for r in frappe.db.sql("""
                select ami.asset, count(distinct am.name) as cnt
                from `tabAsset Movement Item` ami
                inner join `tabAsset Movement` am on am.name = ami.parent
                where am.docstatus = 1 and ami.asset in %(n)s group by ami.asset""",
                {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True):
            move_count[r.asset] = r.cnt

    maint_count = {}
    if dt_exists("Asset Maintenance Log") and has_field("Asset Maintenance Log", "asset_name"):
        for r in frappe.db.sql("""
                select asset_name as asset, count(*) as cnt from `tabAsset Maintenance Log`
                where docstatus < 2 and asset_name in %(n)s group by asset_name""",
                {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True):
            maint_count[r.asset] = r.cnt

    # ---------------- purchase invoice through purchase receipt ----------------
    pi_by_pr_item = {}
    if prs:
        for r in frappe.db.sql("""
                select pii.purchase_receipt, pii.item_code, pii.parent
                from `tabPurchase Invoice Item` pii
                inner join `tabPurchase Invoice` pi on pi.name = pii.parent
                where pi.docstatus = 1 and pii.purchase_receipt in %(p)s""",
                {"p": tuple(prs)}, as_dict=True):
            pi_by_pr_item[r.purchase_receipt + "::" + (r.item_code or "")] = r.parent
            pi_by_pr_item.setdefault(r.purchase_receipt + "::", r.parent)

    # ---------------- asset capitalization (created by / consumed in) ----------------
    created_by_cap = {}
    consumed_in_cap = {}
    if dt_exists("Asset Capitalization"):
        if has_field("Asset Capitalization", "target_asset"):
            for r in frappe.db.sql("""
                    select target_asset as asset, name, posting_date from `tabAsset Capitalization`
                    where docstatus = 1 and target_asset in %(n)s""", {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True):
                created_by_cap[r.asset] = r
        if dt_exists("Asset Capitalization Asset Item"):
            for r in frappe.db.sql("""
                    select aci.asset, ac.name, ac.posting_date
                    from `tabAsset Capitalization Asset Item` aci
                    inner join `tabAsset Capitalization` ac on ac.name = aci.parent
                    where ac.docstatus = 1 and aci.asset in %(n)s""", {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True):
                consumed_in_cap[r.asset] = r

    # ---------------- sales ----------------
    sales_by_asset = {}
    if has_field("Sales Invoice Item", "asset"):
        for r in frappe.db.sql("""
                select sii.asset, si.name, si.posting_date, sum(sii.base_net_amount) as amt
                from `tabSales Invoice Item` sii
                inner join `tabSales Invoice` si on si.name = sii.parent
                where si.docstatus = 1 and sii.asset in %(n)s
                group by sii.asset, si.name, si.posting_date
                order by si.posting_date""", {"n": names_t}, as_dict=True):
            sales_by_asset.setdefault(r.asset, []).append(r)

    # =====================================================================
    #  per-asset calculation
    # =====================================================================
    data = []
    for a in assets:
        if a.docstatus == 0:
            status = "Draft"
        elif a.docstatus == 2:
            status = "Cancelled"
        else:
            status = a.status
        if statuses and status not in statuses:
            continue
        if (not statuses) and status == "Cancelled":
            continue

        # --- source document
        pi = a.get("purchase_invoice")
        if not pi and a.get("purchase_receipt"):
            pi = pi_by_pr_item.get(a.get("purchase_receipt") + "::" + (a.item_code or "")) \
                or pi_by_pr_item.get(a.get("purchase_receipt") + "::")
        cap_src = created_by_cap.get(a.name)
        if pi:
            source_type = "Purchase Invoice"
            source_doc = pi
        elif a.get("purchase_receipt"):
            source_type = "Purchase Receipt"
            source_doc = a.get("purchase_receipt")
        elif cap_src:
            source_type = "Asset Capitalization"
            source_doc = cap_src.name
        elif a.get("is_existing_asset"):
            source_type = "Opening (Existing Asset)"
            source_doc = None
        else:
            source_type = "Manual"
            source_doc = None

        if source_filter and source_type != source_filter:
            continue
        if pi_filter and pi != pi_filter:
            continue

        acq_date = to_date_or_none(a.get("purchase_date") or a.get("available_for_use_date"))
        if acq_date and acq_date > to_date:
            continue

        # --- disposal
        disposal_date = to_date_or_none(a.get("disposal_date"))
        disposal_doctype = None
        disposal_doc = None
        sale_amount = 0.0
        if status == "Sold":
            sales = sales_by_asset.get(a.name) or []
            for s in sales:
                sale_amount = sale_amount + flt(s.amt)
                disposal_doctype = "Sales Invoice"
                disposal_doc = s.name
                if not disposal_date:
                    disposal_date = getdate(s.posting_date)
        elif status == "Scrapped":
            if a.get("journal_entry_for_scrap"):
                disposal_doctype = "Journal Entry"
                disposal_doc = a.get("journal_entry_for_scrap")
        elif status == "Capitalized":
            cc = consumed_in_cap.get(a.name)
            if cc:
                disposal_doctype = "Asset Capitalization"
                disposal_doc = cc.name
                if not disposal_date:
                    disposal_date = getdate(cc.posting_date)

        is_disposed = status in ("Sold", "Scrapped", "Capitalized") and disposal_date is not None
        disposed_before = is_disposed and disposal_date < from_date
        disposed_in = is_disposed and between(disposal_date, from_date, to_date)
        if disposed_before and not include_old_disposed:
            continue

        held_at_start = (acq_date is None or acq_date < from_date) and not disposed_before
        acquired_in = acq_date is not None and between(acq_date, from_date, to_date)

        # --- finance book row
        fbr = pick_fb_row(a.name)
        primary_fb = None
        lst = afb_by_asset.get(a.name) or []
        if lst:
            primary_fb = lst[0].finance_book

        # --- journal rows -> depreciation & value adjustments
        dep_before = 0.0
        dep_in = 0.0
        adj_before = 0.0
        adj_in = 0.0
        last_dep = None
        for r in je_rows_by_asset.get(a.name) or []:
            if a.get("journal_entry_for_scrap") and r.je == a.get("journal_entry_for_scrap"):
                continue
            rfb = r.finance_book or ""
            if fb_filter:
                ok = (rfb == fb_filter) or (rfb == "" and include_default_fb)
            else:
                ok = (rfb == "") or (rfb == (primary_fb or ""))
            if not ok:
                continue
            d = getdate(r.posting_date)
            amt = flt(r.amount)
            is_adj = r.je in ava_jes
            if d < from_date:
                if is_adj:
                    adj_before = adj_before + amt
                else:
                    dep_before = dep_before + amt
            else:
                if is_adj:
                    adj_in = adj_in + amt
                else:
                    dep_in = dep_in + amt
            if not is_adj and amt > 0:
                last_dep = d

        # --- capitalized repairs
        rep_before = 0.0
        rep_in = 0.0
        for r in repairs_by_asset.get(a.name) or []:
            d = to_date_or_none(r.dt)
            if d is None or d < from_date:
                rep_before = rep_before + flt(r.amt)
            elif d <= to_date:
                rep_in = rep_in + flt(r.amt)

        gross = flt(a.get(cost_field)) if cost_field else 0.0
        opening_dep_field = flt(a.get("opening_accumulated_depreciation"))

        if disposed_before:
            opening_cost = additions = cap_repairs = disposal_cost = 0.0
            opening_ad = brought_in = dep_period = adj_period = eliminated = 0.0
        else:
            opening_cost = (gross + rep_before) if held_at_start else 0.0
            additions = gross if acquired_in else 0.0
            cap_repairs = rep_in
            opening_ad = (opening_dep_field + dep_before + adj_before) if held_at_start else 0.0
            brought_in = (opening_dep_field + dep_before + adj_before) if acquired_in else 0.0
            dep_period = dep_in
            adj_period = adj_in
            if disposed_in:
                disposal_cost = opening_cost + additions + cap_repairs
                eliminated = opening_ad + brought_in + dep_period + adj_period
            else:
                disposal_cost = 0.0
                eliminated = 0.0

        closing_cost = opening_cost + additions + cap_repairs - disposal_cost
        closing_ad = opening_ad + brought_in + dep_period + adj_period - eliminated
        opening_nbv = opening_cost - opening_ad
        closing_nbv = round(closing_cost - closing_ad, 2)

        gain_loss = 0.0
        if disposed_in:
            nbv_at_disposal = disposal_cost - eliminated
            if status == "Sold":
                gain_loss = sale_amount - nbv_at_disposal
            elif status == "Scrapped":
                gain_loss = 0 - nbv_at_disposal

        # --- system value (for verification)
        if fbr and fbr.get("value_after_depreciation") is not None and a.get("calculate_depreciation"):
            system_nbv = flt(fbr.value_after_depreciation)
        elif a.get("value_after_depreciation") is not None:
            system_nbv = flt(a.get("value_after_depreciation"))
        else:
            system_nbv = gross - opening_dep_field
        if is_disposed:
            system_nbv = 0.0
        variance = 0.0
        if to_date >= today and a.docstatus == 1:
            variance = round(closing_nbv - system_nbv, 2)

        if hide_zero and closing_cost == 0 and opening_cost == 0 and additions == 0 \
                and disposal_cost == 0 and dep_period == 0:
            continue

        purchase_year = ""
        if acq_date:
            purchase_year = str(acq_date.year)

        data.append({
            "asset": a.name,
            "asset_name": a.asset_name,
            "item_code": a.item_code,
            "asset_category": a.asset_category,
            "status": status,
            "source_type": source_type,
            "source_doc": source_doc,
            "purchase_invoice": pi,
            "purchase_receipt": a.get("purchase_receipt"),
            "supplier": a.get("supplier"),
            "purchase_date": a.get("purchase_date"),
            "available_for_use_date": a.get("available_for_use_date"),
            "location": a.get("location"),
            "cost_center": a.get("cost_center"),
            "department": a.get("department"),
            "custodian": a.get("custodian"),
            "qty": flt(a.get("asset_quantity") or 1),
            "dep_method": fbr.depreciation_method if fbr else None,
            "dep_count": fbr.total_number_of_depreciations if fbr else None,
            "dep_freq": fbr.frequency_of_depreciation if fbr else None,
            "opening_cost": opening_cost,
            "additions": additions,
            "cap_repairs": cap_repairs,
            "disposal_cost": disposal_cost,
            "closing_cost": closing_cost,
            "opening_acc_dep": opening_ad,
            "acc_dep_brought_in": brought_in,
            "dep_period": dep_period,
            "value_adj_period": adj_period,
            "acc_dep_eliminated": eliminated,
            "closing_acc_dep": closing_ad,
            "opening_nbv": opening_nbv,
            "closing_nbv": closing_nbv,
            "system_nbv": system_nbv,
            "variance": variance,
            "disposal_date": disposal_date if is_disposed else None,
            "disposal_doctype": disposal_doctype,
            "disposal_doc": disposal_doc,
            "sale_amount": sale_amount if disposed_in else 0.0,
            "gain_loss": gain_loss,
            "movements": move_count.get(a.name) or 0,
            "repairs": repair_count.get(a.name) or 0,
            "maint_logs": maint_count.get(a.name) or 0,
            "last_dep_date": last_dep,
            "purchase_year": purchase_year,
        })

    # =====================================================================
    #  grouping, totals, chart, summary
    # =====================================================================
    group_map = {
        "Asset Category": "asset_category", "Location": "location", "Cost Center": "cost_center",
        "Department": "department", "Status": "status", "Supplier": "supplier",
        "Source Type": "source_type", "Custodian": "custodian", "Item": "item_code",
        "Purchase Year": "purchase_year",
    }
    gfield = group_map.get(group_by) if group_by else None

    totals = {}
    for f in num_fields:
        totals[f] = 0.0
    for r in data:
        for f in num_fields:
            totals[f] = totals[f] + flt(r.get(f))

    out = []
    if gfield:
        groups = {}
        order = []
        for r in data:
            k = r.get(gfield) or "(Not Set)"
            if k not in groups:
                groups[k] = []
                order.append(k)
            groups[k].append(r)
        order = sorted(order)
        for k in order:
            g = {"asset_name": str(k) + "  (" + str(len(groups[k])) + ")", "is_group": 1, "indent": 0}
            g[gfield] = k
            for f in num_fields:
                s = 0.0
                for r in groups[k]:
                    s = s + flt(r.get(f))
                g[f] = s
            out.append(g)
            if not summary_only:
                for r in groups[k]:
                    r["indent"] = 1
                    out.append(r)
    else:
        out = list(data)

    total_row = {"asset_name": "TOTAL  (" + str(len(data)) + " assets)", "is_total": 1}
    for f in num_fields:
        total_row[f] = totals[f]
    if data:
        out.append(total_row)

    # chart: by group field (default category)
    cfield = gfield or "asset_category"
    agg = {}
    for r in data:
        k = r.get(cfield) or "(Not Set)"
        if k not in agg:
            agg[k] = {"cost": 0.0, "ad": 0.0, "nbv": 0.0}
        agg[k]["cost"] = agg[k]["cost"] + flt(r.get("closing_cost"))
        agg[k]["ad"] = agg[k]["ad"] + flt(r.get("closing_acc_dep"))
        agg[k]["nbv"] = agg[k]["nbv"] + flt(r.get("closing_nbv"))
    keys = sorted(list(agg.keys()), key=lambda x: -agg[x]["cost"])[:15]
    chart = None
    if keys:
        v_cost = []
        v_ad = []
        v_nbv = []
        for k in keys:
            v_cost.append(agg[k]["cost"])
            v_ad.append(agg[k]["ad"])
            v_nbv.append(agg[k]["nbv"])
        chart = {
            "data": {
                "labels": keys,
                "datasets": [
                    {"name": "Closing Cost", "values": v_cost},
                    {"name": "Accumulated Depreciation", "values": v_ad},
                    {"name": "Net Book Value", "values": v_nbv},
                ],
            },
            "type": "bar",
            "fieldtype": "Currency",
            "colors": ["#5e64ff", "#ff5858", "#28a745"],
            "barOptions": {"spaceRatio": 0.4},
        }

    draft_count = 0
    draft_value = 0.0
    disposed_count = 0
    variance_count = 0
    for r in data:
        if r.get("status") == "Draft":
            draft_count = draft_count + 1
            draft_value = draft_value + flt(r.get("closing_cost"))
        if r.get("disposal_cost"):
            disposed_count = disposed_count + 1
        if abs(flt(r.get("variance"))) > 0.5:
            variance_count = variance_count + 1

    summary = [
        {"label": "Assets", "value": len(data), "datatype": "Int", "indicator": "Blue"},
        {"label": "Opening Cost", "value": totals["opening_cost"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Grey"},
        {"label": "Additions", "value": totals["additions"] + totals["cap_repairs"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Green"},
        {"label": "Disposals (Cost)", "value": totals["disposal_cost"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Red"},
        {"label": "Closing Cost", "value": totals["closing_cost"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Blue"},
        {"label": "Depreciation (Period)", "value": totals["dep_period"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Orange"},
        {"label": "Closing Acc. Dep.", "value": totals["closing_acc_dep"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Orange"},
        {"label": "Closing NBV", "value": totals["closing_nbv"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Green"},
        {"label": "Gain / (Loss) on Disposal", "value": totals["gain_loss"], "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency,
         "indicator": "Green" if totals["gain_loss"] >= 0 else "Red"},
        {"label": "Disposed in Period", "value": disposed_count, "datatype": "Int", "indicator": "Red"},
        {"label": "Draft Assets", "value": draft_count, "datatype": "Int", "indicator": "Yellow"},
        {"label": "Draft Assets Value", "value": draft_value, "datatype": "Currency", "currency": currency, "indicator": "Yellow"},
        {"label": "Assets with Variance", "value": variance_count, "datatype": "Int",
         "indicator": "Red" if variance_count else "Green"},
    ]

    return columns, out, None, chart, summary


data = run_report(filters)
